description: Work with your Hevy training log: log and update workouts, follow workout changes, build routines and folders, add custom exercises, read an exercise's history and record body measurements.

hevy_deleted_workout_trigger.description: Runs when a workout is deleted in Hevy, with its ID and when it was deleted. Deletions made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

hevy_new_workout_trigger.description: Runs when a new workout is logged in Hevy, with its exercises and sets. Workouts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.exercises: Its exercises, each with its sets.
output.routine_id: The routine it followed, if any.
output.title: The workout's title.

hevy_updated_workout_trigger.description: Runs when a workout is logged or edited in Hevy, with the workout as it now is. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.exercises: Its exercises, each with its sets.
output.routine_id: The routine it followed, if any.
output.title: The workout's title.
